hardRules: No visual asset may be used behind real text/content unless autoSizeStatus is ready or the asset is edited/split until ready.
Labels/ribbons/plaques/wood signs require cap + stretchable center + cap behavior for real HTML text.
Cards/panels/frames require nine-slice (or equivalent) and calm readable center for variable content height.
Backgrounds are decorative layers and must be evaluated for responsive readability only.
Stickers/florals/apples/mushrooms/accents default to decorative-only unless explicitly proven convertible.

labelCapable: These materials were analyzed with caution
cardCapable: Must hold real headings, paragraphs, upload status text, and similar content without clipping or visual breakdown.

futurePackPolicy: Any newly added visual asset pack must be appended to this manifest before production UI text/container use.
Assets marked needs-editing require creation of corrected crop/split outputs and reclassification to ready before use as text surfaces.
